summary: Iteration 8 verified the backend-free refactor. BACKEND (22/22 PASSED in 35s, test_iptv_api.py): all prior 18 tests still pass (channels=688, EPG=665, /api/guide 12h & 24h windows, /api/search 'espn', /api/refresh advances last_refresh, /api/status/source, auth login/verify negatives+positives, POST /api/settings requires Bearer and restores m3u4u defaults) PLUS 4 NEW TestProxy cases: GET /api/proxy?url=https://m3u4u.com/m3u/... returns 200 with #EXTM3U text and >500 #EXTINF lines; GET /api/proxy?url=https://m3u4u.com/xml/... returns 200 with valid <tv>/<channel> XMLTV; GET /api/proxy?url=ftp://... and /api/proxy?url=/relative return 400. Note: the legacy auth endpoints (/api/auth/login, /api/auth/verify, POST /api/settings) still exist server-side, but the frontend UI that consumed them was REMOVED as requested — they are just dormant. FRONTEND (390x844 mobile viewport, web preview via Expo backend proxy): app launched, guide first-painted from in-memory cache within ~5s and rendered 34 epg-channel-* rows and 489 epg-prog-* program cells with the now-line and time header (LIVE program blocks in red). Toggle to Box Grid (testID=mode-box-btn — the task spec said 'epg-box-grid' but the actual testID is mode-box-btn) rendered 76 box-channel-* cards and 76 box-fav-* stars. Tapping box-fav-'AETV.us (m3u4u)' successfully favorited the channel and it appeared under the Favorites tab filtered by the auto-selected 'Favorites' group chip. Tapping box-channel-'AETV.us (m3u4u)' opened the program-detail modal (A&E TV / Storage Wars / Sat Jul 18 · 9:00-9:30 PM · LIVE / 'Watch now' button) — this is app-correct behaviour, tap opens detail rather than jumping straight to /player. Group chips (chip-All / chip-Local / chip-Movies / chip-Sports / chip-Favorites) render and filter. Date chips (date-* for Today, Sun 19, Mon 20, Tue 21) render and switching to next-day reloaded the guide. Search tab: search-input filled with 'espn' returned ESPN / ESPN News / ESPN U / ESPN2 / ESPN(2) / ESPN UHD / ESPN SD / ESPN SHD channel cards; the search-clear ('x') button clears the field correctly. Favorites tab renders Favorites and Reminders sections without error (no explicit 'Recent' heading is shown when the recently-watched list is empty — non-blocking cosmetic). Settings tab: shows only the 'Playlist & EPG' card (Channels loaded 688 / Channels with EPG 665 / Last refreshed Jul 18, 9:00 PM) and the 'About Reminders' card — NO admin login form, NO username/password inputs, NO M3U/EPG URL editors anywhere on the screen (confirmed by screenshot). settings-refresh-btn ('Refresh Playlist Now') is present, tappable, and after tap the on-device sourceStatus still shows 688 channels. ZERO JavaScript errors during any interaction. One non-blocking storage warning: '[storage] setItem(gs_source_cache_v1) failed QuotaExceededError' — the parsed EPG blob exceeds the browser's ~5MB localStorage quota, so on web only the disk cache write fails; in-memory MEM cache still works for the session and native (AsyncStorage) has a much larger quota so this is a WEB-ONLY warning. Deprecated packages detected: none. React Native issues detected: only the carryover 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated' warning (non-blocking, from TimelineGrid.tsx:192).

react_native_issues.issue: Non-blocking RN web deprecation warning still logged on app load: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents'. Reference: /app/frontend/src/components/TimelineGrid.tsx:192 (inline props.pointerEvents on the now-line indicator).

On web preview only, storage.setItem('gs_source_cache_v1', parsed) throws QuotaExceededError because the parsed M3U+EPG payload exceeds the browser's ~5MB localStorage limit. The app still works because MEM (in-memory) holds the parsed data for the session; but each web refresh re-fetches from m3u4u via /api/proxy. Native builds use AsyncStorage which is not affected. Reference: /app/frontend/src/source.ts:181 storage.setItem(CACHE_KEY, parsed).

action_items: OPTIONAL cleanup: migrate props.pointerEvents to style.pointerEvents in /app/frontend/src/components/TimelineGrid.tsx:192 to silence RN web deprecation warning.

OPTIONAL (web preview only): in /app/frontend/src/source.ts consider skipping storage.setItem(CACHE_KEY, parsed) on Platform.OS==='web' (or storing only channels[] without programs{}) to avoid the QuotaExceededError log. Non-blocking — native app is unaffected because AsyncStorage does not hit the browser 5MB limit.

OPTIONAL cleanup: the dormant legacy admin endpoints (/api/auth/login, /api/auth/verify, POST /api/settings, GET /api/settings) still exist in /app/backend/server.py even though the admin UI is gone. If truly backend-free, these can be removed — but keeping them is harmless since nothing in the shipped app calls them. Note: /api/proxy MUST stay because the web preview needs it; the native APK does not use it.

Docs nit: task spec references testID 'epg-box-grid' for the box-grid toggle but the actual testID in /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/index.tsx is 'mode-box-btn' (line 98). No code change needed — just note for future testing agents.
critical_code_review_comments: source.ts: resolveUrl() correctly routes only Platform.OS==='web' requests through `${EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL}/api/proxy?url=`; native returns the https-forced URL directly (lines 39-45). Confirms native APK will NOT call the backend proxy.

source.ts: ensureParsed() has a proper cache-first + TTL (30min) + fallback-to-MEM-on-error strategy (lines 188-203); doFetchParse() catches EPG failures separately (lines 167-174) so a broken XMLTV doesn't blank the channel list.

store.tsx: no more references to the removed api.* object. loadGuide() and refreshSource() from source.ts are used directly (lines 5, 89, 112). First refresh() is awaited (fast cache paint), then refreshSource().then(refresh(true)) is fired in the background non-blocking (lines 125-130) — matches the description in the review request.

settings.tsx: only imports sourceStatus/refreshSource from src/source (line 18). NO imports of AuthContext, api, or any admin routes. UI has only Playlist & EPG stats + Refresh Playlist Now + About Reminders — no username/password inputs, no URL editors — confirmed by DOM inspection and screenshot.

server.py:315-331 /api/proxy correctly validates url scheme (rejects non-http(s) with 400) and uses a 45s timeout with a browser-y User-Agent; wraps upstream failures in 502. Suitable for the web-preview-only role.
storage.setItem is a fire-and-forget in source.ts:180-184 — try/catch already swallows QuotaExceededError. So the warning is logged but doesn't break the flow. Good defensive coding.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of iter-8 flows on web preview — mocked native-only features (VLC playback, local notifications) are correctly stubbed and do not crash

seed_data_creation: None. Backend still preserves m3u4u defaults in DB (TestProtectedSettings restores them). Frontend now hardcodes SOURCE_M3U/SOURCE_EPG in /app/frontend/src/source.ts and no longer reads from backend /api/settings.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend URL: https://iptv-player-guide.preview.emergentagent.com (env EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL). Mobile viewport 390x844. testID map for /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/index.tsx: mode-timeline-btn, mode-box-btn (NOT 'epg-box-grid' as review request said), guide-refresh-btn, guide-retry-btn, date-<value>, chip-<group>. Grid rows: epg-channel-<id>, epg-prog-<id>-<i>, box-channel-<id>, box-fav-<id>. Settings: settings-refresh-btn. Search: search-input, search-clear. Tabs are Expo Router without explicit tab-* testIDs — use get_by_text('TV Guide'|'Favorites'|'Search'|'Settings'). Web preview limitations that MUST NOT be reported as bugs: (1) VLC player is mocked via StreamPlayer.web.tsx so /player screen won't stream; (2) local push notifications for reminders don't fire on web; (3) storage.setItem(gs_source_cache_v1) throws QuotaExceededError because the parsed payload > 5MB — MEM cache still works. Backend proxy /api/proxy is web-only and MUST remain until the app is shipped as a native APK.
